why_agent_cannot: identity verification is required and cannot be performed by an agent
what_human_must_do: Install Cycles Pay from the App Store or Google Play . You can also use the web app at pay.cycles.money , but the phone app holds your keys and signs for it. Warning The keys live on your phone, and Cycles can't restore them. The terms say: "IF YOU LOSE YOUR PRIVATE KEYS, YOUR FUNDS WILL BE PERMANENTLY INACCESSIBLE."
Sign up with an email code, Google or Apple, and choose a personal account. You don't need an invite code. A referral code is optional.
Skip identity checks unless you want bank transfers. Those go through banking partners that ask for KYC.

Fund the account with stablecoins from a wallet or an exchange. Warning This is real money in a beta app. The terms say: "THERE IS NO INSURANCE (SUCH AS FDIC COVERAGE), AND RETURNS ARE NOT GUARANTEED."
Use the app. Send a payment, create or pay an invoice, split an expense, or move part of your balance into a vault.
Open Points in the app to see the missions, the claims and your total.

If you used Cycles Pay before 16 September 2026, follow the in-app move from Neutron to Arc. Warning Cycles says its Neutron contracts stay active only until 1 November 2026. It also reported on 22 September that Neutron had halted, so move old balances as soon as the app lets you.
costs: The app is free, and Cycles advertises "No fees". It publishes no fee schedule. The terms reserve the right to charge a network access fee and other fees, and say beta pricing can end at any time. Bank transfers run through outside providers with their own charges. Signing up costs nothing, and feedback can earn points without a deposit. Most missions need real stablecoins in the app.
risks: Points can't be transferred or sold. Cycles can change or cancel them at any time, and they are forfeited if the program ends. Vault returns vary. The terms list smart contract failure, depegging and loss of principal among the risks, and say Cycles isn't responsible for the outside protocols. The two published audits cover the earlier system on Neutron, and one of them was done by Informal System
